title: Local structure and residue field of a coefficient subalgebra
statement: Let k be a field, Λ an Artinian local k-algebra with residue field K and maximal ideal m, σ:K→Λ a section of reduction, t a finite subset of m, and s a finite subset of K. Assume the image of k in Λ is contained in the subring generated by t and σ(k(s)). Then C_s of [def-weil-pbc-artinian-coefficient-subalgebra] is Artinian local, its maximal ideal is the contraction of m, and its residue field is isomorphic as a k-algebra to k(s). This conclusion requires no flatness, no enlargement of s, and no assumption that t spans all of m.

source.place: Tag 07FG, proof of lemma-helper, polynomial images and final presentation paragraph

proof.text: Put F=k(s). The coefficient containment identifies C_s with the subring generated by sigma(F) and t. Give it its F-algebra structure through sigma|F. If m^n=0, the finitely many monomials in t of degree less than n span this subring over F, because all higher-degree monomials vanish. Thus it is finite dimensional over F and Artinian.

Let J be its ideal generated by t. J is nilpotent. Its quotient is F: every element is sigma(a)+h, with h in J, and applying the ambient residue map proves sigma(F) intersects J trivially. If a is nonzero, a finite geometric series inverts sigma(a)+h. If a is zero, the element is nilpotent and is not a unit in this nontrivial ring. Hence J consists exactly of the nonunits and the ring is local. Reduction in Λ shows J is the contraction of m. The quotient-to-F isomorphism is k-linear because it is induced by ambient reduction, whose restriction to k is the residue structure map; sigma need not be k-linear.

theorem artinian_coefficient_subalgebra_structure
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    [IsArtinianRing Λ] [IsLocalRing Λ]
    (σ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ →+* Λ) (t : Finset Λ)
    (s : Finset (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ))
    (hσ : (IsLocalRing.residue Λ).comp σ = RingHom.id _)
    (ht : (t : Set Λ) ⊆ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Λ)
    (hc : ∀ a : k, algebraMap k Λ a ∈ Subring.closure ((t : Set Λ) ∪
      σ '' (IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)) :
        Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)))) :
    ∃ hA : IsLocalRing (artinianCoefficientSubalgebra k Λ σ t s),
      IsArtinianRing (artinianCoefficientSubalgebra k Λ σ t s) ∧
      @IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (artinianCoefficientSubalgebra k Λ σ t s) _ hA =
        Ideal.comap (artinianCoefficientSubalgebra k Λ σ t s).val.toRingHom
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Λ) ∧
      Nonempty (@IsLocalRing.ResidueField (artinianCoefficientSubalgebra k Λ σ t s) _ hA
        ≃ₐ[k] IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)))
